notes: IRIS v0.2.10 adds an honest shared workspace-change stream for parallel agents and visible, durable model-handoff boundaries. Workspace mutations made through IRIS are attributed to the real agent and optional turn, with bounded diffs where applicable; external filesystem changes are not misattributed. When an agent switches provider or model, the transcript records the source, destination, and time while keeping the marker out of model input. Full TypeScript and Rust test suites passed before this release.
